# Felix

> Felix tells UK agencies which brands are likely to hire an agency like theirs in the next 6 to 18 months, whether that's a new agency of record, a first hire or a project, why, and how to get in before the brief goes out.

Felix is run by RandomSandwiches. It's for founders, MDs and new business leads at agencies of every kind: creative and advertising, brand and design, media, PR and comms, corporate and public affairs, social and content, ecommerce and marketplace, SEO, search and performance, web, app and product, B2B marketing, CRM and loyalty, experiential, employer brand and internal comms, and health and pharma.

## What Felix does

- Works out who each agency sells to (a CMO, a head of ecommerce, a comms director, a CTO and so on) and watches the signs that move that buyer. An Amazon or marketplace agency hears about new ecommerce leads and marketplace moves, not new CMOs.
- Scores brands on how likely they are to hire an agency for work in the agency's discipline, as a level (High, Medium, Low to medium, Low) with a timing window.
- Shows the signs behind each score, such as a new owner, a new CEO or CMO, senior marketing roles advertised, or a long-standing agency, each with its public source and date.
- Gives a route plan for each brand: who decides, who can introduce you, any pitch consultant, a one-page letter to send and when to email.
- Covers the basics too: decision-makers with contact details, agencies on record and ad spend.
- Works in the Felix app, Slack, HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Claude and ChatGPT (via MCP), an API, and email.

## Start free, then get Felix

- [The Shortlist by Felix](https://felixhq.app/shortlist/): free every Thursday, the same for everyone. The five UK brands whose chance of hiring an agency rose most that week, with scores and reasons.
- [Your free brief](https://felixhq.app/#request): free, once, made for your agency. The top 10 brands in your sector, scored, plus full route plans for 3 brands you name.
- [Felix](https://felixhq.app/#pricing): £199 a month at the founding price (list £349). Every brand in your sectors plus your own targets, scored daily, with alerts, route plans, contacts and ad spend.

## Notes

- Every fact links to a public source and shows the date it was checked.
- Scores are Felix's judgement from public signs, not a guarantee.
- Felix doesn't scrape LinkedIn or use other vendors' data.
- Contact: hello@felixhq.app

## More detail
- Felix watches 36 signs in 7 families: ownership and money, leadership and people, marketing team and hiring, agency relationship, performance and strategy, brand and launches, media and spend.
- For each decision-maker, Felix shows their career, the agencies they've worked with, what they've said in public about their priorities and the best way to approach them. Professional, public and sourced information only.
- Warm routes come from the agency's own CRM, team inboxes and calendars, past clients and former colleagues. Felix also writes a one-page letter and posts it for you.
- [Track record](https://felixhq.app/track-record/): every call Felix makes, with its date, and outcomes as they come in. The hit rate will be published once there's enough history.
